# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Defender Antivirus

Core configuration of Defender Antivirus: real-time protection, cloud protection, scan schedule, and what happens on a detection.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog (endpointSecurityAntivirus) |
| Assignment | All Devices |
| checkId | `INTUNE-BASE-012-DefaultAVPolicy` |
| Source | OpenIntuneBaseline Windows v4.0 — ES - Defender Antivirus - D - AV Configuration |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Defender_Antivirus.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Defender_Antivirus.json) |

> 11 -> 28 settings. allowintrusionpreventionsystem is retained; OIB leaves it out because Microsoft has deprecated the setting. Since OIB v4.0, OIB itself sets moderate and high to quarantine; the own override for moderate has thereby become redundant and has been removed. Low remains an override.

## Standards

| Framework | Controls |
|---|---|
| ISO/IEC 27001:2022 | A.8.7 Protection against malware |
| NIS2 art. 21(2) | art. 21(2)(e) security in network and information systems acquisition, development and maintenance, including vulnerability handling |
| CIS Controls v8.1 | 10.1 Deploy and Maintain Anti-Malware Software<br>10.2 Configure Automatic Anti-Malware Signature Updates<br>10.4 Configure Automatic Anti-Malware Scanning of Removable Media<br>10.6 Centrally Manage Anti-Malware Software<br>10.7 Use Behavior-Based Anti-Malware Software |
| NIST CSF 2.0 | DE.CM-09<br>RS.MI-01 |

What this means per standard and what is needed organisationally alongside it: [COMPLIANCE.en.md](../../../COMPLIANCE.en.md).
